purpose: Separate prior exposure from still-eligible prospective tests. Listed material may calibrate or falsify KEYSTONE but may not be reported as blind prediction.

exposed_before_native_seal.detail: One numbered route was read as three ordinary motifs followed by an altered terminal motif; a comparison route was read as four ordinary motifs, with both ending at node 26.

exposed_before_native_seal.item: SUN comparison to the printed route motif
exposed_before_native_seal.detail: The 3-plus-altered versus 4-ordinary reading was explicitly compared with three ordinary SUN generations plus an exceptional terminal operation versus four ordinary generations.
The values 2/3, 3/4, 1/2, 16/15 and 15/16 were known before observable selection.
A reported Kuja-line height of 2d/3 was noticed and explicitly rejected as recovery of the repeated SUN operator. The primary Mahesh source is not yet authenticated in this build.
Recursion, construction reuse, parameter families, multiple routes, convergence, inward/outward traversal, manifestation/return symbolism, concurrency and dependency were investigated before sealing.
Kulaichev, Huet, Chiodo, Mahesh, geometric-constraint theory and practitioner traditions were already identified as relevant source families.

prospective_but_not_pristine_targets.condition: Mapping method and tolerances must be frozen before resolving identities. Printed-document inconsistencies must not be silently repaired to favor the route hypothesis.

future_external_requirement: A later domain with no pre-inspection of target motifs or values is required for genuinely blind validation.
reporting_rule: Never relabel an exposed item as withheld, unseen, blind, independently predicted or independently recovered.
